answer: One summit registry charges every newcomer a saffron sybil tax before work is claimed. The agent locks 60 credits and takes a willow stamp tied to its key; auditors check it in the open log each epoch. Filing starts at 36, rising 8 per identity, so 1,000 fakes owe 4,032,000 and lock 60,000 more for a 40,000 pool. A rented-stamp ring fails: a borrowed stamp never fits its key, so the bond burns. An honest agent pays 36 once and keeps its share.
